_meta: A tiny corpus for lexical retrieval, where the answer passage and the query use different words for the same thing. Each document has text (the passage a lexical retriever indexes) and expansions (short predicted questions a doc2query step generates from the passage -- the questions a user would ask that this passage answers). In a real system a small model generates the expansions; here they are a fixture standing in for that step. The gold document is the one that actually answers the query. The point: the query shares almost no vocabulary with the gold passage's text, so ranking by the text alone puts a lexically-overlapping but wrong document on top; appending the predicted questions to the indexed text closes the vocabulary gap from the document side and lifts the gold document to rank 1. cosine similarity is over term-count vectors; every score is computed.
query: how do plants make food from light
